phases.next: 10 s short of 60. Remaining levers each need a decision: (1) split the Blender unwrap into spatial chunks run in parallel Blender processes (~8 s, changes seams and atlas layout, needs a quality pass); (2) fewer photos (rejected on quality); (3) faster hardware or running the whole job on compute-box. Production's 2-vCPU droplet will be slower than these numbers.

production_on_compute_box_plan.decided: 2026-10-19: leave the pipeline as is; run the whole scan job on compute-box in production
production_on_compute_box_plan.shape: compute-box runs the API, worker, SQLite and artifact store natively; the Droplet stays the public edge (Caddy TLS, reverse proxy over Tailscale to compute-box) and keeps the web container
production_on_compute_box_plan.why_not_job_offload: a job-level offload would ship ~300 MB of photos per walk over Tailscale after the last byte; with the server on compute-box they arrive during the walk as the phone streams them

facts_2026_10_19.power: laptop on AC, battery 80%; sleep held off only by caffeinate; standby and powernap on; autorestart not set
facts_2026_10_19.docker: none; runs native venv like the offload server

steps: 0 decisions and machine prep (user, needs admin): dedicate the machine; free ~100 GB or attach an SSD; pmset sleep 0 / autorestart 1 / standby 0; Tailscale and the server start without a login (FileVault blocks this after a power cut)

1 prepare compute-box (no prod impact): clean checkout of the deployed master commit at ~/sp-prod, venv from requirements.lock, prod .env copied from the Droplet, launchd agent with KeepAlive bound to the Tailscale IP, SP_OFFLOAD_URL unset
2 rehearse: restore last night's prod backup into it, measure Droplet<->compute-box throughput (needs >= ~3 MB/s for a live walk), replay a real upload through the Droplet proxy, time milestones
3 migrate in a short maintenance window: stop the Droplet API, sqlite .backup + rsync artifact store, verify row and file counts, start compute-box, point Caddy at it
4 deploys and backups: deploy = fetch + venv sync + launchd restart on compute-box; nightly sqlite .backup + artifact rsync back to the Droplet, which becomes the cold standby
5 verify with a real TestFlight walk; rollback = Caddy back to the Droplet's API container plus the latest backup
risks: home laptop uptime and power cuts
